policy.exclusionNotes: hideInAppIds on a peer hides it when More apps runs inside those host app ids. moreAppsExcludeIds on the host also hides those peer ids. Website ignores both. showInMobileApp: false hides peer from in-app More apps only (website ignores). Missing showInMobileApp ⇒ true (backward compatible). In-app More apps require status.<devicePlatform>==Published (never InProcess). showInMobileApp false hides even if Published; missing showInMobileApp ⇒ true.
